session.summary: User is planning a beginner's vegetable garden in their backyard, seeking guidance on suitable vegetables, supplies, garden layout, planting schedules, and pest control for a zone 7b climate.

records.title: Beginner's Vegetable Garden Project Plan
records.content: This record serves as the central plan for starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard, targeting a 4x8 feet raised bed with a focus on beginner-friendly vegetables and manageable steps for completion by early May.
records.description: A comprehensive project plan for a beginner's vegetable garden with detailed sections on layout, supplies, and schedules.

sections.heading: Garden Layout
sections.content: Planning a raised bed of 4 feet by 8 feet in a backyard location that receives about 6 hours of sunlight daily. Need to confirm if 6 hours of sunlight is sufficient for most vegetables. Research ideal dimensions for beginner raised beds.

sections.heading: Supplies Needed
sections.content:
- Soil
- Containers or raised bed materials (for 4x8 feet bed)
- Seeds (tomatoes, lettuce, others TBD)
- Basic gardening tools
- Watering system (consider simple drip irrigation)
- Fencing or natural pest deterrents (to protect against rabbits and other pests)

sections.heading: Planting Schedule
sections.content: Target planting completion by early May. Specific planting calendar to be detailed in a separate note for reference throughout the season.

sections.heading: Additional Considerations
sections.content:
- Research companion planting (e.g., basil near tomatoes for mutual benefit).
- Address pest control with a preference for natural deterrents over chemicals.
- Confirm suitability of vegetables for zone 7b climate.

records.content: A reference guide for the planting schedule of selected vegetables to ensure timely planting and harvesting throughout the season, targeting completion by early May.
